page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top; page number at top left. The "„" marks at line starts are printed quotation marks, one per line, copied as printed. Nothing in the margins except the lone dagger-like marks, which are not text. Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is omitted.

main_text.p: „ Accedit, quòd eodem capite idem Ja- „ cobus, postquàm dixisset, Eum quicun- „ que totam Legem servaret, in uno autem „ offenderet, esse omnium reum; prædictam „ sententiam ex eo confirmat, Quia qui „ dixit Non mœchaberis, dixit Non occides: „ quódsi non mœchaberis, occidas autem, fa- „ ctus es transgressor Legis. Ubi asserit A- „ postolus illum etiàm puniendum, qui „ deliquerit in unum Præceptum, quia re- „ verâ transgressor est Legis, quam to- „ tam implere debebat. Quæ certè argu- „ mentatio planè inutilis esset, nisi omnes „ teneremur ad obedientiam Legis de quâ „ loquitur. Concedimus igitur in hâc „ Disquisitione, gentes, quibus nunquàm „ Lex Mosis innotuit, materiâ Legis Mo- „ saïcæ jure naturali cognitâ, teneri, & „ obligari; adeóque secundùm eandem „ judicandas, juxtà Apostolum Rom. 11, „ 12, 13, 14. Et obligatione per legis- „ lationem Mosaïcam superinductâ non „ teneri, quamdiù promulgationem isti- „ us Legis non subeunt: at verò ubi Deus „ Legem illam Mosaïcam iis promulgat, „ vel per Scripturas, vel oraculum, vel præ-

page.notes: Doubtful: the printed line "Quia qui" and "Disquisitione" and "Mosis" are as printed. Several letters are blurred by print and stains (e.g. "Legis" in line 4, "teneri" with ink spot). Printed text runs to "præ-" at the foot, continued on the next page. Quotation marks „ at each line start are printed, not transcribed as words.
